start_here: Say to your AI: "Show me where my run from the event id stands." It asks tool:workflow-run-show with that event id and hands back the run and its waiting tasks.
no_lists_because: It reads the person's calendar tasks and writes nothing: no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Give the event_id the start answered (or any event id a waiting task was made from).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:workflow-run-show and input {event_id, database}.
3. Read result.runs: each run's cause key, its workflow and its tasks with their status and step.
4. A run with no tasks has not reached a waiting step yet; the answer does not show task details.

worked_examples.title: Show a run by the event id its start answered
worked_examples.ask: Show me where my run from event workflow-run-start:0000 stands.
worked_examples.given: The event id a start answered.
worked_examples.hands_back: result {event_id, runs: [{run_key, workflow, tasks: [{id, status, step}]}]}; a task in To do at say-the-job is the run waiting for an answer.
